cases.study_information: The antibodies are captured through goat anti-human IgG on a CM5 chip; soluble recombinant human IL-17A or IL-17F is the analyte. Multi-cycle SPR at 25 C uses HBS-P+ with 300 mM NaCl, 3 mM EDTA and 0.05% P20, with a 1:1 fit. Neutral SPR is displayed as pH7.5 by benchmark convention; the original report states pH7.4. Only the variable domains differ; the tested molecules are full-length antibodies, not Fab.

dependence_note: Shared sources must be interpreted at the study-family level.
title: Predicting human IL-17A affinity after local antibody engineering
